title: Large Corner Condo-Broadway 2 miles, free parking!
description:
Just 2 miles from Broadway, this spacious 700 sq ft corner condo offers free parking, fast Wi-Fi, a large iving room, full kitchen with dishwasher, and in-unit washer/dryer. 2x the size of most hotel rooms and perfect for work or relaxation. Kitchen is well stocked so you can cook meals. Quick, friendly support, I try to reply within minutes, and almost always under an hour. Direct phone number provided to reach us if needed.

Free Parking!
Full Size Bed
Sleeper Sofa
Bathroom essentials provided

The space
The condo has a bedroom with a TV and walk in closet.  Ironing board, iron, fan and extra pillows provided.  
The living room is an open space shared with the kitchen.  It includes a sleeper sofa, chair, bench, dining table and TV.  Cooking supplies are also provided (pots and pans, colander, knives, silverware, plates, etc.)
Bathroom is stocked with shampoo, conditioner, and body wash.  Make up wipes also provided.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire condo.

Other things to note
Free parking in building parking lot (back of buliding).  Free wifi.
